cancellation_reason.description: Flint-normalized reason the payment intent was canceled. Unknown processor values are returned as payment_canceled.

current_payment_action.description: Typed browser authority for the current standalone payment action. Complete it, then call the same confirm endpoint without a replacement credential. Absent when no browser action is required.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

merchant_net_money.description: Captured amount minus processing_fee_money. Later merchant assessments and credits are separate balance effects.

processing_fee_money.description: Flint's all-in processing fee for this payment. It is the complete price Flint charges to process the payment, never a provider cost passed through. The fee is final once the card payment is captured or the ACH payment succeeds; canceled payments and failures before success have none. Your net for the payment is captured_money minus this fee. Refunds do not return or revise it.

support_reference.description: Opaque payment reference to share with merchant support. Do not parse its format.

Money.description: Monetary amount represented as integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 currency code.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit, such as cents for USD.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this amount.

PendingPaymentAction.description: Client-side action required before continuing a payment. Resume an order through PayOrder with payment_attempt_id, or continue a standalone PaymentIntent through its confirm endpoint without a replacement credential.

action_type.description: Product-level action type. payment_authentication applies to a payment leg; payment_method_authentication applies to saving a future-billing payment method.

client_action.description: Direct browser authority required to finish this action before continuing through Flint. Unlike collection guidance, this payload includes a client secret.

pending_action_id.description: Stable Flint action ID. Use this to deduplicate a repeated action projection while resuming an attempt.

subject.description: The attempt subject that requires browser action. Exactly one of payment_intent or setup_payment_source is present.

PaymentClientAction.description: Typed provider-specific browser action payload. Execute the selected provider action before continuing the owning payment through Flint.

account_id.description: Stripe connected account ID to pass as stripeAccount when initializing Stripe.js.

payment_intent.description: PaymentIntent authority for an order payment authentication action.

publishable_key.description: Stripe publishable key for the active Flint payment mode; use this with account_id when loading Stripe.js.

setup_intent.description: SetupIntent authority for a saved-payment-method authentication action.

client_secret.description: PaymentIntent client secret to pass to Stripe.js handleNextAction.

stripe_js_call.description: Stripe.js operation to perform. Today this is handle_next_action.

client_secret.description: SetupIntent client secret to pass to Stripe.js handleNextAction.

stripe_js_call.description: Stripe.js operation to perform. Today this is handle_next_action.

PendingPaymentActionSubject.description: Typed subject for a pending order payment action. Exactly one subject is present.

payment_intent.description: PaymentIntent that requires buyer authentication. It can be a standalone intent or an order-owned payment leg.

setup_payment_source.description: Future-billing payment method setup that requires buyer authentication.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.

message.description: Flint-authored merchant-facing payment failure message. This is stable explanatory text, not raw provider copy.

merchant_account_session.description: Request body fields to send to POST /v1/merchant-account-sessions when action_type is create_merchant_account_session.

required_scope.description: API key scope required to call the public endpoint in url, when the action points at another Flint API endpoint.

url.description: Public endpoint or launch URL for this remediation action, when applicable.

component.description: Resolver-recommended component to send to POST /v1/merchant-account-sessions.

amount.description: Signed amount in the currency's minor unit, such as cents for USD.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this amount.

type.description: Funding-method family. Wallet payment options use card because their underlying funding source is a card.

promotion_code.description: Promotion code that was accepted but did not apply, on a promotion_declined warning.

reason.description: Stable Flint reason code. On a promotion_declined warning this is the promotion decline reason (for example superseded_by_better_offer); an unrecognized value falls back to not_eligible. See the Promotions reference for the full list.

would_have_applied_money.description: Discount amount this promotion would have applied had it won, on a promotion_declined warning.
